records.read: Read the complete OneMap address search response, found=1, building THE ADELPHI, 1 COLEMAN STREET, postal 179803; copied returned WGS84 coordinates exactly. No tile or third-party geometry copied.

supplementaryEvidence.title: Marsita Omar, Adelphi Hotel, Singapore Infopedia, NLB
supplementaryEvidence.read: Read article body through Closure: the later hotel occupied 1 and 2 Coleman Street at North Bridge Road; the hotel closed in 1973 and the present Adelphi Complex was built on the same site. This distinguishes that site from the earlier 3 Coleman Street hotel address.

supplementaryEvidence.title: National Museum of Singapore, The Adelphi Hotel, accession 2001-03461
supplementaryEvidence.read: Read catalogue description: the hotel’s final location was North Bridge Road/Coleman Street and the replacement building is The Adelphi. The NLB article gives more precise closure/demolition chronology; no catalogue image is reproduced.

supplementaryEvidence.title: Arkib Negara Malaysia, Penubuhan Malaysia 16 September 1963
supplementaryEvidence.read: Read article body, chronology and photograph caption: Tunku addressed the foreign correspondents at Adelphi Hotel, Singapore, on 27 May 1961 when proposing federation. This directly connects the event to the hotel whose replacement site is identified by NLB.
